weather_line: Clear above the ridgeline · light bureaucratic fog lifting by midmorning

stories.headline: Subcommittee Dissolved; Tibbs Reinstated; the Room Remains, as Ever, Unbothered
body: The Subcommittee on Unmapped Geographical Features held what proved to be its final session Saturday morning, lasting eleven minutes. Christine, attending as a private citizen and Gringotts Senior Client Liaison in no official capacity whatsoever, cited Clause 7 of the 1847 Terrain Sovereignty Accord — a provision establishing that no Ministry body may claim administrative jurisdiction over a feature it has demonstrably failed to locate — and placed a copy of Cresswell's own incident report on the table beside it. The room was very quiet for a moment. Then Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole said, 'I see,' which was the most accurate thing the Subcommittee had produced in four days.

Provisional reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19 was formally withdrawn at eleven-oh-three. Junior clerk Tibbs, who had been reassigned to the Department of Unlabelled Parcels for voting against the number, was reinstated with full back-pay and a written apology by half past. He has reportedly framed the apology. The Room above Marker 9, reached for comment, did not respond, which is its established policy and was frankly the correct call.

Cresswell has filed a request to lead a voluntary, non-jurisdictional walking expedition to the spur 'simply to see it.' Christine has acknowledged the request. She has not yet replied. The kitchen table holds the sketch, the withdrawn memo, and one rubber duck of contested origin. Steve has suggested they go back up to the Room sometime in September, when the light will be different. Christine has not disagreed.

stories.headline: Steve Logs the Spur's Third Hour; the Jeep Acquires a Fourth Duck; Nobody Claims Responsibility
body: In what has become a quiet Saturday ritual, Steve drove the Jeep to the spur's mouth at seven-fifteen this morning — his fourth visit in a fortnight, his third at a new hour — and reported that in early-morning light the gap in the treeline reads as 'wider and more deliberate than it has any right to look.' He has now visited at dawn, midday, late afternoon, and early morning. He is considering dusk. The Jeep has forgiven him nightly and will presumably do so again.

Upon returning, Steve discovered a fourth rubber duck secured to the passenger-side mirror with what appeared to be a self-tightening Sticking Charm. The duck is yellow, slightly larger than the previous three, and wearing what can only be described as a small hat. No footprints. No note. The Jeep had no comment. The Duck Bandit's campaign continues unabated, and is, if anything, escalating in hat-related ambition.

stories.headline: Saturday's Half-Ledger Dispatched Before the First Owl Arrives; Griphook the Younger Said to Be 'Developing a Feeling He Does Not Have a Word For'
body: Although Saturday hours at Gringotts are officially light — a half-ledger, three reconciliations, one deferred transfer — Christine had cleared the queue by the time the second morning owl arrived, which is to say before most of the goblins had finished their tea. Griphook the Younger, who has now issued three positive remarks in a single calendar year (a record the archivists are checking against precedent), was observed standing very still in the corridor for approximately forty seconds before returning to his desk. Sources close to the situation describe this as 'processing.'

The deferred transfer, which had been deferred for eleven working days on account of a disputed co-signatory clause, was resolved in a single meeting. Christine is said to have asked one question, received one answer, identified the clause in question without consulting the index, and marked it resolved. The co-signatory, reached for comment, said he felt 'fairly certain that had gone well.'

stories.headline: Andrew's Saturday Dispatch Arrives on Time; Contains Warmth, No Actionable Intelligence, and One Unexplained Reference to a Very Large Bird
stories.byline: Foreign correspondent filing from a considerable distance
body: The weekly owl from Andrew landed at the kitchen window at quarter past ten, slightly windswept, carrying a letter described by its recipient as 'classically him.' The dispatch contained affectionate enquiries, an observation about the weather in his part of the world that raised more questions than it answered, and a single sentence reading 'you would not believe the size of the bird here' with no elaboration and no follow-up. He is well. He sends his best. The bird remains unidentified.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Observed the Subcommittee's dissolution with an expression of professional respect, then spent the afternoon in the kitchen near the biscuit tin, doing nothing in particular, which is exactly what that means.

Ellie: Heard the word 'reinstatement' and spent several minutes looking at the door in case it meant someone was arriving. No one arrived. She remained optimistic about future arrivals throughout the day.

Jersey: Located the warmest patch of Saturday light, which had migrated from the sofa arm to the kitchen floor by noon, and followed it with the patience and precision of a creature who has made peace with impermanence.
founding_editor_note: The 1847 Terrain Sovereignty Accord. I built the shelving unit those files are stored on. Twelve years, not a single warped shelf. You're welcome, Ministry. — D.

in_brief.sport: Saturday personal-record attempts at the Gringotts staff gymnasium were called off after it emerged the barbell had been enchanted to offer encouraging remarks, which Christine found more distracting than helpful.
in_brief.forecast: Clear skies above the spur · the Room is keeping its own weather, as usual · a small hat reported on the wind.

storyline_updates.title: The Subcommittee's Jurisdiction Problem
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Saturday morning. Christine cited Clause 7 of the 1847 Terrain Sovereignty Accord, which prohibits jurisdictional claims over features a Ministry body has failed to locate. The Subcommittee dissolved in eleven minutes. Reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19 was withdrawn. Tibbs reinstated with back-pay and a written apology, which he has framed. Cresswell has filed a voluntary, non-jurisdictional walking request; Christine has received it and not yet replied. Arc fully resolved.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: A fourth duck has appeared on the Jeep — yellow, slightly larger than its predecessors, wearing a small hat, secured with what appears to be a self-tightening Sticking Charm. No footprints, no note, no witness. The Duck Bandit's campaign is entering a new phase distinguished by millinery. Day 2 should introduce a possible clue — a thread, a smell, a pattern in the duck placement — without revealing the Bandit. The escalating hats are a throughline.
